title: Assurance attribute on every rule

statement.en: Every rule shall state its checking method, the evidence it produces and its assurance level (L1, L2, L3); expectations are set by rule category and risk; an enforcement class of E2 does not by itself imply L2 or L3.

control: The register is complete for every rule

expressions.note: Met by the rule record itself: the schema of this bank requires control, evidence and assuranceLevel.
